Hitmonlee

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Hitmonlee is a Fighting-type Kicking Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 49.8 kg. It evolves from Tyrogue. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 455.
